text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 41 · 环形空间站的餐叙舱.
Environment:  A spacious empty communal dining compartment following the gentle arc of a rotating space station, warm timber tables, ivory chairs, small prepared tea setting, luminous curved ceiling ribs. Tall windows show the station ring sweeping across a blue-white planet. One comfortable foreground table and a clear passage, bright optimistic civilian life in orbit.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 41 · 环形空间站的餐叙舱. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
